say:1:1432908001:1.text: So... it wasn't some secret lover. He just looked up to Indris and wanted to join the Guard, huh?
say:1:1432908001:1.source_cn: 你说，是因为他崇拜因度厄，想加入卫队……
say:1:1432908001:1.male: So... it wasn't some secret lover. He just looked up to Indris and wanted to join the Guard, huh?
say:1:1432908001:1.female: So... it wasn't some secret lover. He just looked up to Indris and wanted to join the Guard, huh?

say:2:1432908002:1.text: Well, that's a lot easier to swallow. I'll choose to believe that.
say:2:1432908002:1.source_cn: 罢了，总比挂坠盒里藏着情人的画像要好，我就暂且这样相信吧。

say:3:1432908003:1.text: As for your reward—don't worry, I keep my promises.
say:3:1432908003:1.source_cn: 答应你的酬谢，我不会食言的。
say:3:1432908003:1.male: As for your reward—don't worry, I keep my promises.
say:3:1432908003:1.female: As for your reward—don't worry, I keep my promises.
